# 3.
```{r}
ct_map <- c(
  Ast = "astrocytes",
  MG  = "Microglia",
  OD  = "Oligodendrocytes",
  OPC = "OPC",
  IN  = "Neurons",     # fuse IN  → Neurons
  Ext = "Neurons",     # fuse Ext → Neurons
  End = "Endothelial"
)

remap_ct <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% names(ct_map), ct_map[x], x)

training_data[, celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]
full_data[,     celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]

full_data[, chr := tstrsplit(peak, "-", keep = 1L)]
training_data[, chr := tstrsplit(peak, "-", keep = 1L)]

# Merge on full identity
index_cols <- c("peak", "gene", "celltype", "chr")
setkeyv(full_data, index_cols)
setkeyv(training_data, index_cols)
data <- full_data[training_data, nomatch = 0L]

# Labels: 1 = pos, 2 = strong neg -> make 0/1
data[label == 2L, label := 0L]
data <- data[label %in% c(0L, 1L)]

cat(sprintf("Number of training instances: %s\n", nrow(data)))
cat(sprintf("Number of positives: %s\n", sum(data$label == 1L)))
cat(sprintf("Number of negatives: %s\n\n", sum(data$label == 0L)))


celltypes <- sort(unique(data$celltype))

```

```{r}
# --- Define pgBoost-only parameters ---
pgboost_params <- list(
  booster           = "gbtree",
  objective         = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric       = "aucpr",
  max_depth = 15,
  eta = 0.05,
  gamma = 10,
  min_child_weight = 8,
  nthread = 4,
  scale_pos_weight = 1,
  subsample = 0.8)

pgboost_features <- c("cicero", "signac", "scent", "peak_gene_distance", "closest_tss")
pgboost_features <- intersect(pgboost_features, names(data))  # ensure they exist

```

```{r}
train_xgb <- function(X, y, params, folds, max_nrounds = 500) {
  params$nrounds     <- NULL
  params$nthread     <- NULL
  params$objective   <- "binary:logistic"
  params$eval_metric <- "aucpr"
  
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(X), label = y)
  
  # Cross-validation by chromosome
  cv <- xgb.cv(
    data = dtrain,
    params = params,
    nrounds = max_nrounds,
    folds = folds,
    nthread = 8,
    early_stopping_rounds = 10,
    verbose = 1
  )
  
  best_nrounds <- cv$best_iteration
  
  bst <- xgb.train(
    params  = params,
    data    = dtrain,
    nrounds = best_nrounds,
    nthread = 8,
    verbose = 1
  )
  
  list(model = bst, best_nrounds = best_nrounds)
}


predict_and_score <- function(model_obj, X_test, y_test) {
  bst <- if (is.list(model_obj)) model_obj$model else model_obj
  p_hat <- predict(bst, as.matrix(X_test))
  
  logloss <- -mean(y_test * log(p_hat + 1e-15) + (1 - y_test) * log(1 - p_hat + 1e-15))
  pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = p_hat[y_test == 1],
                        scores.class1 = p_hat[y_test == 0],
                        curve = FALSE)
  
  list(
    preds = data.table(prob = p_hat, label = y_test),
    metrics = list(logloss = logloss, auprc = pr$auc.integral)
  )
}

```

```{r}
results_pgboost <- list()

for (ct in celltypes) {
  message("Held-out cell type (pgBoost-only): ", ct)
  
  train_idx <- data$celltype != ct
  test_idx  <- data$celltype == ct
  
  X_train <- data[train_idx, ..pgboost_features]
  y_train <- data$label[train_idx]
  chr_train <- data$chr[train_idx]
  
  X_test <- data[test_idx, ..pgboost_features]
  y_test <- data$label[test_idx]
  
  # --- Chromosome folds ---
  folds <- split(seq_along(chr_train), chr_train)
  
  # --- Train model ---
  pgboost_model <- train_xgb(X_train, y_train, pgboost_params, folds = folds, max_nrounds = 500)
  
  # --- Save model ---
  xgb.save(pgboost_model$model,
         fname = file.path(model_dir, paste0("xgb_pgboost_", ct, ".model")))
  
  # --- Predict + score ---
  res_pgboost <- predict_and_score(pgboost_model, X_test, y_test)
  
  # --- Save predictions ---
  preds_pgboost <- cbind(
  data[test_idx, .(peak, gene, chr, celltype)],
  model = "pgBoost-only",
  res_pgboost$preds
)

  fwrite(
    preds_pgboost,
    file = file.path(pred_dir, paste0("predictions_pgboost_", ct, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  # --- Store summary metrics ---
  results_pgboost[[ct]] <- list(
    pgboost = res_pgboost$metrics
  )
}

saveRDS(results_pgboost, file = file.path(pred_dir, "summary_metrics_pgboost.rds"))
```

```{r}
compute_pr_curve <- function(dt) {
  pos <- dt$prob[dt$label == 1]
  neg <- dt$prob[dt$label == 0]
  if (length(pos) == 0 || length(neg) == 0) return(NULL)
  pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = pos, scores.class1 = neg, curve = TRUE)
  data.table(
    recall = pr$curve[,1],
    precision = pr$curve[,2],
    aucpr = pr$auc.integral,
    n_pos = sum(dt$label == 1),
    n_neg = sum(dt$label == 0)
  )
}

pr_curves <- all_preds[, compute_pr_curve(.SD), by = .(celltype, model)]
pr_curves_summary <- pr_curves[, .(AUPRC = unique(aucpr)), by = .(celltype, model)]

print(pr_curves_summary)
```

```{r fig.height= 6.5, fig.width= 8}
capitalize_first <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(s) {
    if (toupper(s) == "OPC") return("OPC")
    paste0(toupper(substring(s, 1, 1)), substring(s, 2))
  })
}
pr_curves_summary[, celltype := capitalize_first(celltype)]
```

```{r fig.width= 7, fig.height=5}
pr_curves_all <- data.table::copy(pr_curves)

# --- 1. Aggregate PR curves across cell types ---

agg_pr <- pr_curves_all[, .(
  mean_precision = mean(precision, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd_precision   = sd(precision, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_ct           = uniqueN(celltype)
), by = .(model, recall_bin)]

# --- 2. Rename models for clarity ---
agg_pr[, model := fifelse(model == "pgBoost-only", "pgBoost features",
                   fifelse(model == "tuned model", "All features", model))]

# --- 3. Compute mean AUPRC per model ---
auprc_summary <- pr_curves_all[, .(mean_aucpr = mean(unique(aucpr))), by = model]
auprc_summary[, model := fifelse(model == "pgBoost-only", "pgBoost features",
                          fifelse(model == "tuned model", "All features", model))]

# --- 4. Enforce consistent color order ---

agg_pr[, model := factor(model, levels = model_levels)]
auprc_summary[, model := factor(model, levels = model_levels)]
```

# Distance based
```{r}
pgboost_pred_dir   <- file.path(PRED_DIR, "XGBoost_pgboostfeatures")
consensus_pred_dir <- file.path(PRED_DIR, "xgBoost_tuning_500evals_allParams_new")

pgboost_files   <- list.files(pgboost_pred_dir, pattern = "^predictions_pgboost_.*\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
consensus_files <- list.files(consensus_pred_dir, pattern = "^predictions_tuned_.*\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

pgboost_preds <- if (length(pgboost_files)) rbindlist(lapply(pgboost_files, fread), fill = TRUE) else data.table()
consensus_preds <- if (length(consensus_files)) rbindlist(lapply(consensus_files, fread), fill = TRUE) else data.table()

if (nrow(pgboost_preds))   pgboost_preds[,   model := "pgBoost features"]
if (nrow(consensus_preds)) consensus_preds[, model := "All features"]

all_preds <- rbindlist(list(pgboost_preds, consensus_preds), fill = TRUE)

key_cols <- c("peak", "gene", "celltype", "chr")
if (all(key_cols %in% names(data))) {
  all_preds <- merge(
    all_preds,
    data[, .(peak, gene, celltype, chr, peak_gene_distance, closest_tss)],
    by = key_cols,
    all.x = TRUE
  )
}

# --- Compute log-distance bins ---
all_preds[, log_distance := log10(peak_gene_distance + 1)]
all_preds <- all_preds[is.finite(log_distance)]

all_preds[, dist_bin := cut(
  log_distance, breaks = seq(3, 7, by = 0.2),
  include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE
)]

# --- AUPRC per distance bin (global) ---
compute_bin_auprc <- function(dt) {
  if (length(unique(dt$label)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(
    scores.class0 = dt$prob[dt$label == 1],
    scores.class1 = dt$prob[dt$label == 0],
    curve = FALSE
  )
  pr$auc.integral
}

# Bin midpoints for plotting
bin_breaks <- seq(3, 7, by = 0.2)
bin_mids <- bin_breaks[-1] - 0.1

# PLOT 1: GLOBAL (pooled)
dist_perf_global <- all_preds[, .(AUPRC = compute_bin_auprc(.SD)), by = .(model, dist_bin)]
dist_perf_global[, dist_mid := 10^bin_mids[dist_bin]]

p1 <- ggplot(dist_perf_global, aes(x = dist_mid, y = AUPRC, color = model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(1e3, 1e4, 1e5, 5e5),
    labels = c("1 kb", "10 kb", "100 kb", "500 kb")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic distance (peak–TSS)",
    y = "AUPRC",
    title = "Global (pooled across cell types)"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("All features" = "#1b9e77", "pgBoost features" = "#d95f02")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14, base_family = "montserrat_family") +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.8, 0.85),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )


# PLOT 2: MEAN across cell types

dist_perf_ct <- all_preds[, .(AUPRC = compute_bin_auprc(.SD)), by = .(model, celltype, dist_bin)]
agg_perf <- dist_perf_ct[, .(
  mean_AUPRC = mean(AUPRC, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd_AUPRC   = sd(AUPRC, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(model, dist_bin)]
agg_perf[, dist_mid := 10^bin_mids[dist_bin]]

p2 <- ggplot(agg_perf, aes(x = dist_mid, y = mean_AUPRC, color = model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(1e3, 1e4, 1e5, 5e5),
    labels = c("1 kb", "10 kb", "100 kb", "500 kb")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic distance (peak–TSS)",
    y = "Mean AUPRC",
    title = "Mean AUPRC across cell types"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("All features" = "#1b9e77", "pgBoost features" = "#d95f02")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14, base_family = "montserrat_family") +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.8, 0.85),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# -------------------------------
# Display both

p1 + p2 + plot_layout(ncol = 2)
```

```{r fig.width = 14, fig.height= 5}
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
library(data.table)
library(GenomicRanges)

# 1. Read your eQTL data
eqtl_dt <- fread("/mnt/germain/work/tomohl/pgboost-project/data/eqtl_files/training_data_snppg_aggregated_new.tsv.gz")
eqtl_dt[, c("chr", "start", "end") := tstrsplit(peak, "-", fixed = TRUE)]
eqtl_dt[, `:=`(start = as.numeric(start), end = as.numeric(end))]
eqtl_dt[, peak_mid := (start + end) / 2]
eqtl_dt[, gene_id_clean := sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)]

# --- Normalize chromosomes ---
eqtl_dt[, chr := sub("^chr", "", chr)]   # remove "chr" prefix

# 2. Extract gene coordinates from EnsDb
gene_coords <- genes(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86, columns = "gene_id")

gene_dt <- data.table(
  gene_id = gene_coords$gene_id,
  chr = as.character(seqnames(gene_coords)),
  gene_start = start(gene_coords),
  gene_end = end(gene_coords),
  strand = as.character(strand(gene_coords))
)

# 3. Merge (now names match!)
eqtl_dt <- merge(
  eqtl_dt,
  gene_dt,
  by.x = c("gene_id_clean", "chr"),
  by.y = c("gene_id", "chr"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

# 4. Compute TSS + distance
eqtl_dt[, gene_tss := ifelse(strand == "-", gene_end, gene_start)]
eqtl_dt[, distance_bp := abs(peak_mid - gene_tss)]


ggplot(eqtl_dt, aes(x = distance_bp, fill = factor(label))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, alpha = 1) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(1e3, 1e4, 1e5, 5e5),
    labels = c("1 kb", "10 kb", "100 kb", "500 kb")
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(
    palette = "Dark2",
    name = "Label",
    labels = c("1" = "Positive", "2" = "Negative", "3" = "Unclassified")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~factor(label,
                    levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                    labels = c("Positive", "Negative", "Unclassified")),
             scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic distance (peak–TSS)",
    y = "Number of eQTL links",
    title = "Distribution of eQTL link distances per label"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 15, base_family = "montserrat_family") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", family = "montserrat_family"),
    # Add this line to move the legend to the bottom
    legend.position = "bottom"
```

# SHAP-based feature contribution vs. distance
```{r fig.height= 7.5, fig.width = 17}
xgb_model <- xgb.load(
  "/mnt/germain/work/tomohl/pgboost-project/output/xgBoost_outputs/models/consensus_models/xgb_consensus_allfeatures.model")

full_data     <- fread(data_file)
training_data <- fread(training_file)

# --- Harmonize cell type naming ----------------------------------------------

ct_map <- c(
  Ast = "astrocytes",
  MG  = "Microglia",
  OD  = "Oligodendrocytes",
  OPC = "OPC",
  IN  = "Neurons",
  Ext = "Neurons",
  End = "Endothelial"
)
remap_ct <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% names(ct_map), ct_map[x], x)
training_data[, celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]
full_data[,     celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]

# --- Merge training subset with features -------------------------------------

full_data[, chr := tstrsplit(peak, "-", keep = 1L)]
training_data[, chr := tstrsplit(peak, "-", keep = 1L)]

index_cols <- c("peak", "gene", "celltype", "chr")
setkeyv(full_data, index_cols)
setkeyv(training_data, index_cols)
data <- full_data[training_data, nomatch = 0L]

# --- Prepare labels -----------------------------------------------------------

data[label == 2L, label := 0L]
data <- data[label %in% c(0L, 1L)]

# --- Feature matrix -----------------------------------------------------------

predictor_file  <- "/mnt/germain/work/tomohl/pgboost-project/output/xgBoost_outputs/predictors.txt"
predictor_names <- fread(predictor_file, header = FALSE)[[1]]

feature_matrix <- as.matrix(data[, ..predictor_names])
dmatrix        <- xgb.DMatrix(data = feature_matrix)

# --- Compute SHAP values ------------------------------------------------------

shap <- predict(xgb_model, dmatrix, predcontrib = TRUE)

shap_dt <- as.data.table(shap)
shap_dt[, BIAS := NULL]                      # remove bias column
setnames(shap_dt, predictor_names)

# Attach metadata
shap_dt[, `:=`(
  distance_bp = data$peak_gene_distance,
  label       = data$label,
  celltype    = data$celltype,
  gene        = data$gene,
  peak        = data$peak
)]



# --- Long format for SHAP values ---------------------------------------------

id_columns <- c("distance_bp", "label", "celltype", "gene", "peak")

long_shap <- melt(
  shap_dt,
  id.vars        = id_columns,
  variable.name  = "feature",
  value.name     = "shap_value"
)

feature_groups <- data.table(feature = predictor_names)

# Internal group mapping (collapse multi-column features)
feature_groups[, group := fifelse(
  grepl("^tad_", feature), "TAD",
  fifelse(grepl("^predEnhancer_", feature), "PredEnhancer", feature)
)]

feature_groups[, plot_label := fcase(
  feature == "peak_gene_distance", "Distance to TSS",
  feature == "ATACmean", "Peak accessibility prevalence (mean)",
  feature == "ATACvariance", "Peak accessibility prevalence (variance)",
  feature == "cicero", "Cicero",
  feature == "scent", "SCENT",
  feature == "signac", "Signac LinkPeaks",
  feature == "gene_logCPM", "Gene expression (logCPM)",
  feature == "peak_logCPM", "Peak accessibility (logCPM)",
  feature == "conservation", "Conservation score",
  feature == "closest_tss", "Binary closest link",
  feature == "rex", "Range extender feature",
  feature == "distNearest_peakCentric", "Candidate-centric distance score",
  grepl("^predEnhancer_", feature), "Predicted enhancer activity",
  grepl("^tad_", feature), "TAD scores",
  default = feature
)]

# Merge with grouping table
long_shap <- merge(long_shap, feature_groups[, .(feature, group, plot_label)], 
                   by = "feature", all.x = TRUE)

long_shap[is.na(group), group := feature]  # fallback: keep feature name

# --- Distance binning ---------------------------------------------------------

long_shap[, dist_bin := cut(
  distance_bp,
  breaks = c(0, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 200000, 500000),
  labels = c("1kb","5kb","10kb","50kb","100kb","200kb","500kb"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)]

# --- Aggregation --------------------------------------------------------------

long_shap[, shap_value := as.numeric(shap_value)]

agg <- long_shap[, .(
  mean_abs = mean(abs(shap_value), na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(group, plot_label, dist_bin, label)]

# Normalize within each distance × label bin
agg[, rel_contrib := mean_abs / sum(mean_abs), by = .(dist_bin, label)]

# Facet labels
agg[, label := factor(label, levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Positive", "Negative"))]
agg[, dist_bin := factor(dist_bin,
  levels = c("1kb","5kb","10kb","50kb","100kb","200kb","500kb"))
]

# --- Plot ---------------------------------------------------------------------

okabe_ito <- c(
  "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442",
  "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#999999",
  "#009988", "#332288", "#88CCEE", "#117733",
  "#DDCC77", "#882255", "#AA4499"
)

ggplot(agg, aes(x = dist_bin, y = rel_contrib, color = plot_label, group = plot_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ label) +
  scale_color_manual(values = okabe_ito) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic distance (peak–TSS)",
    y = "Relative SHAP contribution",
    title = "Feature contribution by distance and label"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

agg_all <- long_shap[, .(
  mean_abs = mean(abs(shap_value), na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(group, plot_label, dist_bin)]

# Normalize within each distance bin
agg_all[, rel_contrib := mean_abs / sum(mean_abs), by = dist_bin]

# Plot
ggplot(agg_all, aes(x = dist_bin, y = rel_contrib, color = plot_label, group = plot_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2, stroke = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = okabe_ito, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic distance (peak–TSS)",
    y = "Relative feature contribution"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20, base_family = "Montserrat") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 17, lineheight = 0.9),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linewidth = 2, size = 2.2),
      ncol = 1
    )
  ) +
  # ← This adds the full border around the plot
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6))
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Point 3 — Model confidence vs. genomic distance
############################################################

library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)

# --- 1. Compute predicted probabilities ---------------------------------------
data[, pred_prob := predict(xgb_model, dmatrix)]

# --- 2. Bin distances ---------------------------------------------------------
data[, dist_bin := cut(
  peak_gene_distance,
  breaks = c(0, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 200000, 500000),
  labels = c("1kb","5kb","10kb","50kb","100kb","200kb","500kb"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)]

# --- 3. Summarize model confidence per bin and label --------------------------
conf_summary <- data[, .(
  mean_prob = mean(pred_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd_prob   = sd(pred_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
  n         = .N
), by = .(dist_bin, label)]

conf_summary[, se := sd_prob / sqrt(n)]
conf_summary[, label := factor(label, levels = c(1,0), 
                               labels = c("Positive", "Negative"))]

# --- 5. Plot summary (mean ± SE) ---------------------------------------------
ggplot(conf_summary, aes(x = dist_bin, y = mean_prob, color = label, group = label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_prob - se, ymax = mean_prob + se), width = 0.05) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Positive" = "#009E73", "Negative" = "#D55E00")) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic distance (peak–TSS)",
    y = "Mean predicted probability ± SE",
    color = "True label",
    title = "Average model confidence by distance and label"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}
library(xgboost)
library(data.table)

# Prepare a reduced dataset with only distance
data_dist <- data[, .(peak_gene_distance, label)]

# DMatrix
dmatrix_dist <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = as.matrix(data_dist[, "peak_gene_distance", with = FALSE]),
  label = data_dist$label
)

# Train a simple distance-only model
params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "aucpr",
  max_depth = 3,
  eta = 0.1
)
xgb_dist <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dmatrix_dist,
  nrounds = 200,
  verbose = 0
)

# Predict and compute AUPRC per distance bin
data[, pred_dist := predict(xgb_dist, dmatrix_dist)]
data[, dist_bin := cut(
  peak_gene_distance,
  breaks = c(0, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 200000, 500000),
  labels = c("1kb","5kb","10kb","50kb","100kb","200kb","500kb"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)]

# Compute AUPRC per bin
library(PRROC)
aupr_by_bin <- data[, {
  pr <- pr.curve(
    scores.class0 = pred_dist[label == 1],
    scores.class1 = pred_dist[label == 0],
    curve = FALSE
  )
  .(AUPRC = pr$auc.integral)
}, by = dist_bin]

# Plot
ggplot(aupr_by_bin, aes(x = dist_bin, y = AUPRC, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, color = "#0072B2") +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "#0072B2") +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic distance (peak–TSS)",
    y = "AUPRC (distance-only model)",
    title = "Predictive power of genomic distance alone"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```
